recovery_policy.decision: DP-11/P5: 2 h recovery window for rituals missed while the OpenBot host is off; separate batch, activate after R4-11 is accepted
recovery_policy.late_outcome: status_only record, no model call; agenda carried to the next occurrence
recovery_policy.idempotency_key: meeting_id + original_occurrence_date (the scheduled date before any holiday move)
recovery_policy.holiday: not due on national holidays; a weekly meeting that falls on a holiday moves to the next business day

dependencies.rule: D-sync waits until each listed daily ran or became status_only for the same local date; its own window still ends at 07:25+120 min (09:25). Every dependency window ends earlier (latest: D-trust 07:15+120 = 09:15), so dependencies are always resolved before the D-sync deadline. If the D-sync deadline passes, D-sync becomes status_only.
dependencies.consistency: D-sync participants (publisher + directors editorial, creative, growth, intelligence, trust) match the listed dailies

boundary_tests: host off overnight -> previous day meetings become status_only
two restarts inside the window -> one execution
D-sync with a dependency still pending at 08:00 -> waits; dependency becomes status_only at its deadline -> D-sync runs before 09:25
Monday holiday: W-pautas moves to Tuesday 08:00 with key W-pautas+<Monday date>; a second restart on Tuesday does not duplicate

rescheduling.holiday_move: weekly or monthly meeting due on a holiday moves to the next business day, same local time, keeping the original idempotency key and recording rescheduled_date
rescheduling.collision: a meeting runs at most once per original occurrence; a moved occurrence that lands on a day where the next regular occurrence of the same meeting is also due runs once, with both keys recorded
rescheduling.supersession: no monthly-replaces-weekly rule is adopted (pending a separate decision)
